_comment: Stage 0 grids (decisions S0-2, S0-3, approved 2026-11-11). Gate thresholds are a DRAFT until fixed before the first real run (stage_0_toy_baseline.md section 4).

G-A.purpose: Yardstick L*(m) at alpha = 1, plus strong/weak regimes and seed variance

G-B.purpose: Width-scaling exponents in strong (gamma=-1) and weak (gamma=0.55) regimes at other alphas

G-C.purpose: Step A scouting (2026-11-15): weight decay values beyond the G-A grid edge (gamma = -1) and between -1 and 0, same widths, alpha = 1, 3 seeds, to find where the best gamma really is before the 10-seed runs

G-D.purpose: Step B (2026-11-15): extra seeds 3-9 for the gamma values chosen after G-C, to be pooled with seeds 0-2 already run in G-A (gamma -1, -0.55, 0) and G-C (gamma -2, -0.3) for 10 seeds in total; fp32; the baseline yardstick is the best gamma per width

G-E.purpose: Step B follow-up (2026-11-15): in G-D the best gamma at m = 63, 100, 150 was -2.0, the edge of the grid. Part 1: gamma -3 and -4 at m = 63, 100, 150, seeds 0-9, to see whether more negative is still better. Part 2: width 225 with gamma -4 to 0, seeds 0-9, so that the 1.5x-width target for m = 150 exists. fp32.

G-S1P.purpose: Stage 1 pilot (proposals D-S1-1..3, to find the useful range of the penalty strength lambda; seeds 0-2 only, the verdict uses seeds 3-9). Per width, three arms: plain overlap penalty with gamma 0; plain penalty with the best baseline gamma for that width (15: -0.55, 25: -1.0, 63: -2.0, from the 10-seed table); frequency-weighted penalty with the same best gamma. lambda in {1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1} (moved up one decade from the first proposal after a scale check at m = 25: at the baseline solution lambda x |grad P| / |grad of the task loss| is 0.001 at 1e-5, 0.009 at 1e-4, 0.09 at 1e-3, 0.9 at 1e-2). fp32. Results go to results/stage0/G-S1P.

G-S1F.purpose: Stage 1 final grid (the pilot G-S1P showed the best lambda at the top of its range, 0.1). Both arms use the best baseline gamma per width (15: -0.55, 25: -1.0, 63: -2.0). Penalty strengths 0.3, 1, 3 on seeds 0-9, plus 0.1 on seeds 3-9 (seeds 0-2 at 0.1 already exist in G-S1P with identical settings). Lambda is chosen on seeds 0-2 and judged on seeds 3-9, compared with the 10-seed baseline. 222 runs, fp32. Results go to results/stage0/G-S1F.

G-S2P.purpose: Stage 2 pilot (2026-11-15): does the leakage penalty help, first with perfect labels (ORA-L), then with an SAE's labels (SAE-L, width 63 only)? Seeds 0-2, best baseline gamma per width. Penalty strengths bracket the value whose pull on the weights at the baseline solution equals the Stage 1 selected weighted penalty (scale check: about 8e-4 / 9e-3 / 1.7e-3 at widths 15 / 25 / 63), times 0.3, 1, 3, 10. SAE settings: the best N = 1000 setting of each SAE type in the A1 screen (not a validated choice: no SAE passed the ruler gate). 54 runs, fp32. Judge against the baseline at gamma* and the Stage 1 weighted arm on the same seeds (G-A / G-C / G-S1F).

G-S2Q.purpose: Stage 2 pilot follow-up (2026-11-15): G-S2P showed the oracle-label leakage penalty (ORA-L) hurting at every strength, with even the weakest strength already at the minimum possible row overlap. Same three widths, seeds 0-2, best gamma, but strengths 1/1000, 1/100, 1/30, 1/10 and 1/3 of the weakest strength used in G-S2P (15: 3e-4, 25: 3e-3, 63: 5e-4), to find out whether any weaker strength helps. ORA-L only. 45 runs, fp32.
